id.description: Unique identifier for the select input, used for accessibility and form submission

name.description: Name of the select input, used for form submission

options.description: Array of option objects with 'value' and 'label' properties

defaultValue.description: Default selected value for the select input

value.description: Current selected option. Takes precedence over defaultValue.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the first option

onChange.description: JavaScript function to call when the selected option changes

onBlur.description: JavaScript function to call when the select input loses focus

error.description: An error message that is displayed when the input value is invalid

success.description: A success message that is displayed when the input value is valid

hint.description: Hint text to provide additional guidance

required.description: Whether the select input is required, meaning that the user must select an option before submitting the form

disabled.description: Whether the select input is disabled

formGroup.description: Whether to wrap the label/hint/error/control in a `.usa-form-group`. Set to `false` when composing inside another form group.
